pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which pair of syllables has the same initial and final but a different meaning because of the tone? (1 mark)
   A. dà (big) and xiǎo (small)
   B. mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)
   C. nǐ (you) and hǎo (good)
   D. bā (eight) and mā (mother)

2. What does 上面 (shàngmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bathroom
   B. Door
   C. Garden
   D. Above

3. Which sentence means "The door is on the left."? (1 mark)
   A. 椅子在桌子下。
   B. 冰箱在厨房。
   C. 门在左边。
   D. 电视在桌子上。

4. Which Chinese word means "to speak"? (1 mark)
   A. 笑 xiào
   B. 说 shuō
   C. 牙 yá
   D. 耳朵 ěrduo

5. Which sentence means "Goodbye!"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 你呢?
   C. 谢谢!
   D. 再见!

6. Which sentence means "On Wednesday I go to school."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期天,去教堂。
   B. 明天是星期四。
   C. 星期五,去清真寺。
   D. 我星期三去学校。

7. Read the pinyin: wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. We cut the cake.
   C. My birthday is on 5 March.
   D. We sing.

8. What does 叫 (jiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To be called
   B. Hello
   C. Thank you
   D. Hello (polite)

9. What does 妹妹 (mèimei) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who
   B. Mother
   C. To have, there is
   D. Younger sister

10. In 我星期三去学校, what does 星期三 tell us? (1 mark)
   A. What
   B. Who
   C. When
   D. Where

11. Which sentence means "The window is above the sofa."? (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱在厨房。
   B. 沙发在门旁边。
   C. 窗户在沙发上面。
   D. 电视在哪儿?

12. How can you stay safe with a digital reading journal? (1 mark)
   A. Use it without asking
   B. Share it with strangers
   C. Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   D. Post your address online

13. What does 这 (zhè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger brother
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Older sister
   D. This

14. What does 爸爸 (bàba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger brother
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Love
   D. Father

15. Which word is pronounced hóngshuǐ? (1 mark)
   A. 洪水
   B. 天气
   C. 云
   D. 太阳

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛肉 and 女儿. (2 marks)

17. Arrange the words to make a sentence and translate: 礼物 / 送 / 朋友 / 我. (3 marks)

18. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" (2 marks)

19. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." and "Who is this?" (4 marks)

20. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nà shì wǒ dìdi. (2 marks)

21. Write the difference in meaning between chuáng and chuāng. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)
   Only the tone separates mā and mǎ.

2. D — Above
   上面 (shàngmiàn) means above.

3. C — 门在左边。
   门在左边。 (mén zài zuǒbian.) means "The door is on the left.".

4. B — 说 shuō
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

5. D — 再见!
   再见! (zàijiàn!) means "Goodbye!".

6. D — 我星期三去学校。
   我星期三去学校。 (wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.) means "On Wednesday I go to school.".

7. C — My birthday is on 5 March.
   wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. is 我的生日是三月五号。, which means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

8. A — To be called
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

9. D — Younger sister
   妹妹 (mèimei) means younger sister.

10. C — When
   It is the time word.

11. C — 窗户在沙发上面。
   窗户在沙发上面。 (chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.) means "The window is above the sofa.".

12. C — Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   Keep personal information private.

13. D — This
   这 (zhè) means this.

14. D — Father
   爸爸 (bàba) means father.

15. A — 洪水
   洪水 is pronounced hóngshuǐ and means flood.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 牛肉: niúròu, beef. 女儿: nǚ'ér, daughter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 My friend gives me a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the translation.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie. 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: That is my younger brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: chuáng 床 is a bed and chuāng 窗 is a window. The tones are different.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.
